title: triorchos strictus

It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits in treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Triorchos strictus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
